PIXEL RHYTHMS / NEW ATLANTIS

Architecture that listens.

Gold ribs hold their symmetry. Pearl bells drift through the open sea. Light gathers in the architecture and settles into the water below.

This palace is an exploration of New Atlantis: a world where instruments, living systems, and architecture belong to one environment.

The three pads take you through the hall. Drag to look around, or move freely with the scroll wheel and WASD. Discover the details through the field guide. Use Light to change the atmosphere and Sound to bring your own music.

World study 01 · November 2026. Inspired by the Jellyfish Palace Krea / H3 film. Existing audio response from the Living Particles branch; living currents are ambient motion.
